main_text.l: Ʒ Ludon fal,Tonabit: nos de æ re Cam-
re: & proprie, utpote de Deo dictum.
uti & nos, saltem olim. Majoribus enim
res, wang·teeth dicti, à wang, gena,
maxilla: unde rythmus ille vetus: And
in witnesse that this is sooth; I bite
the war with my wang tooth: id est,
mordeo dente meo maxillari. De quo

Words in black letter (e.g. "And in witnesse...") are set in bold-like type and reproduced without markup.
